summary.key_theme: Netflix 面臨來自 YouTube 與其他串流媒體的激烈競爭，導致用戶參與度下滑及營收成長放緩，引發華爾街分析師下調評級。

bullish.title: Netflix Is Down 42% in a Year and the Investor Who Exited in June Just Bought Back In
bullish.reason: 知名投資人 Steve Weiss 重新買入 Netflix，顯示部分市場參與者認為該股在經歷大幅回調後具備長期價值。

bullish.title: 2 Growth Stocks That Could Double by 2030
bullish.reason: 分析師看好 Netflix 在 2030 年前的獲利成長潛力，認為其具備長期複利回報的特質。

bullish.title: Is Netflix (NFLX) Worth More Than Its Cash Flow Suggests?
bullish.reason: 探討公司現金流與股價脫鉤的可能性，暗示市場可能過度悲觀。

bearish.title: This Analyst Just Downgraded Netflix Stock, And YouTube May Be to Blame
bearish.reason: HSBC 分析師 Mohammed Khallouf 將 Netflix 評級下調至「持有」，並指出 YouTube 對用戶時長的爭奪正削弱 Netflix 的競爭優勢。

bearish.title: Netflix (NFLX) Is Down 8.7% After Wells Fargo Flags Engagement Risks From YouTube And Rivals
bearish.reason: 富國銀行 (Wells Fargo) 因用戶參與度風險與競爭加劇下調評級，導致股價單日顯著下跌。

bearish.title: Netflix's Revenue Growth Has Slowed for 2 Straight Quarters
bearish.reason: 營收成長率連續兩季下滑（從 17.6% 降至 13.4%），且管理層預測成長放緩趨勢尚未結束。

bearish.title: GOOGL, NFLX Stocks In Focus — Alphabet's YouTube Reportedly Rolls Out Fresh Tools To Prevent Creators From Defecting To Netflix
bearish.reason: YouTube 推出新工具以留住頂尖創作者，直接威脅 Netflix 的原創內容策略與人才吸引力。

bearish.title: What Would A Real Market Crash Do To Netflix Stock After This Fall?
bearish.reason: 股價已較高點下跌 43%，市場擔憂若發生大盤崩盤，Netflix 的高估值將面臨進一步修正。

bearish.title: Can Disney's International Streaming Expansion Challenge NFLX & AMZN?
bearish.reason: 迪士尼透過在地化原創內容擴張國際市場，進一步擠壓 Netflix 的全球市占率。

neutral.title: Call of the Day: Netflix
neutral.reason: 投資委員會針對 Netflix 進行討論，未給出明確買賣建議，僅為市場觀點交流。

neutral.title: Are Netflix Shares Still Worth Watching?
neutral.reason: 文章總結 Netflix 近期股價缺乏穩定性，屬於中性觀察報告。

neutral.title: S&P 500, Dow, Nasdaq Drop As Yields Spike Amid Calls For More Rate Hikes
neutral.reason: 提及 Netflix 隨大盤因利率上升而下跌，屬於總體經濟環境影響，非公司基本面因素。
